title: Pianos that show the scale and chords
thisBuild: Hold, next to the scale and chords: + and − set how many notes keep sounding after you lift. The first that many notes hold; later ones play normally. Press a held note again to let it go, or tap Let go. Held keys get a yellow bar on the piano, and with Repeat or an arp on, held notes keep repeating.
Hold any pad for its menu, like a right click. Piano drops a keyboard right under that pad's row and lights the pad's bottom edge. One per row: four pads, a piano, four pads, a piano.
Pianos show your scale: in-scale keys glow softly, out-of-scale keys dim, the root gets a pink dot.
Chords: Play chord plays the whole chord. Show chord plays only the key you press and lights the chord's other notes for you to play yourself.

The sound picker sorts by instrument (kicks, snares, hats, percussion, bass, keys, leads, pads, voices, FX, chops) and by feel (punchy, long, dark, bright, tonal, gritty, busy), with Favorites up top.
A beat light and the line under the top bar pulse with the beat: pink on the one.
Scroll bars you can grab on every page, and View size in the ☰ menu.
watch: Set Hold to 3, play a chord, then play a melody over it.
Pick a scale and Triads, switch to Show chord, and play a piano.
Find a sound with By type, then a feel, and star it.
limits: Creature cards, the Ring, jams and duels stay on the site.
